name: icon-swap
title: Icon Swap
description: Icon swap for vertical reels: a plus blurs, shrinks and turns away as the done mark blurs in, like a toolbar action changing state. Tone, size, shape and blur are fields. Brand palette, Montserrat, sized for the 780 px graphics field. Mount it inside a clip with data-composition-id="icon-swap": its own timeline nests there.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Button fill and glyph colour. Accent rides --brand.

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Button box and glyph size, from a toolbar chip to a hero action.

variables.label: Shape
variables.description: Corner treatment of the button box.

variables.label: Blur
variables.description: Scales the blur radius the timeline drives through the swap, from a light haze to a full smear.
